description: Is an x402 endpoint reliable for a task at a price? Asks the catalog's lookup service for services matching a task at or under max_price_usd, sorted by known-answer pass rate over the last n paid calls, then price. Each result has its paid receipts (time, tx, Basescan link, charged, delivered, pass/fail), last check time and a stale flag. Services broken on the seller's side come back under facts_only, not sorted. Sends client=vc-mcp: 5 free lookups per UTC day for that client name, then the service answers HTTP 402 (x402, $0.02 USDC on Base), which this tool reports but does not pay. Payment never changes results, sort order or listings.

endpoint.description: a service id or endpoint URL instead of a task

max_price_usd.description: maximum listed price per call in USD

payer.description: optional: your 0x wallet, so a later payment to a returned vendor can be confirmed on-chain

task.description: task name, e.g. web-search, crypto-news, weather, token-balance

name: lookup
